name: Recreus Filaflex 95A Foamy

retraction.note: Recreus recommends 2.5-6 mm at 75 mm/s. 4 mm on every travel, however short (min_travel 0), and 5 mm pushed back (restart_extra 1): at 2.5 mm out and 2.5 mm back the first 6 cm after a travel printed thin on the MK3S (about 1.5 mm of filament short), as the foamy strand needs extra push to build its pressure up again.

notes: Dry at 55 C for at least 1 h. Direct-drive extruder recommended. Foams at 245-250 C; lower flow and higher temperature foam more.
